summary: The task analysis packet for P1.A2 is well-defined, adhering to ADR-043 and ADR-038. The scope is strictly bounded to transient synthetic seed storage with clear isolation of the proof-root directory. The design correctly addresses the critical "close-before-delete" requirement and implements necessary safety bounds for the janitor to prevent accidental data loss outside the designated `Paths.cache/dubbridge-p2p/proofs` directory. The security constraints regarding logging and URI handoff are explicitly addressed.
